evidence: Captures 8 and 57 days after the 2020-08-04 election show a re-election site of sitting Glendale mayor Jerry Weiers with volunteer forms and "PAID FOR BY WEIERS 2020".

The 2013 captures (255 days before the 2014-05-06 election) hold only the 2010 campaign: the announcement says "Announcement to Run for Mayor 2010" and the homepage says "VOTE MAY 4TH" and "© 2010". The archive shows no 2014 content on fraimformayor.com.

The 2017-12-12 capture (35 days after the 2017-11-07 election) is titled "Coleman A. Young II - for Mayor of Detroit" and keeps the 2017 campaign content: "We Will Win The Election", canvassing and fundraiser galleries. No pre-election capture exists, but the content belongs to this race.
The 2014-05-20 capture (14 days after the 2014-05-06 election) is the "Fraim for Mayor" site with "Donate Now", issues and volunteer pages, and news posts dated May 2014.
notfitformayor.com (2019-06-07, 1 day before the runoff) is an attack site against opponent Greg Brockhouse: "Bought and Paid for by Public Safety Unions". It is not Nirenberg's own campaign site.

mayoradler.com (captures 2018-02 to 2019-03) is the mayor's office site with State of the City speeches and "About the Mayor's Office". The footer reads "CONTACT US Austin Mayor's Office 301 W 2nd St"; it has no campaign or 2018 election content.

The excerpted 2018 captures (161 and 289 days before the election) show Griggs's City Council District 1 site. The archive shows the same domain in 2019 as "Scott Griggs for Dallas Mayor", with "A new kind of mayor for Dallas" and "Until Runoff Day". The domain is his mayoral campaign site, but the excerpted pages are council-era pages.

The only capture (2018-01-19, 73 days after the 2017-11-07 election) is "Raymond Dehn for 59B": "I'm running for re-election in district 59B" (state house). The archive has no 2017 capture of raymonddehn.org that shows mayoral content.

Both captures (2015-08-01, -94 days; 2015-12-16, +43 days) show a Japanese moving-company review blog ('引越し業者の口コミを徹底比較'). The domain mikebellfortoledo.com held no Bell campaign content around the 2015 special election.
The 2019-07-29 capture (-99 days) is a book promotion page, 'David Rice's Desert Soliloquy', for a memoir about living in the Avawatz Mountains. It has no mention of Charlotte or a mayoral campaign.

All four captures (2018-08-02, -243 days) are from 'Paul Soglin For Governor' with the banner 'Elect Paul Soglin for Governor 2018'. They concern the 2018 Wisconsin governor race, not the April 2019 Madison mayoral election.

The 2021-03-23 capture (+140 days) is titled 'Farrah Khan for Irvine Mayor' and carries 'Paid for by Farrah Khan for Mayor 2020'. It is the campaign site for this 2020 Irvine mayoral election, captured after the election.

All captures (2018-08-23, -467 days) are server utility pages on bieter4boise.com: 'phpinfo()', 'PHP Prober', an Opcache panel and a phpMyAdmin login. No campaign content for Bieter or the 2019 Boise election appears.

Captures from 2019-07-23 (-224 days) and 2020-06-18 (+107 days) show an Indonesian online gambling blog ('seputar judi online'). The domain andrewjanzforcongress.com also names a congressional race, and it holds no Fresno mayoral campaign content.

The 2016-08-11 captures (+96 days) are titled 'Dan Pope For Mayor' and say 'I have the leadership experience to help move Lubbock forward'. He cites nine years on the LISD board, which matches the 2016 Lubbock race.

Captures from 2020-08-12 (+8 days) and 2020-09-30 (+57 days) show a Glendale re-election site with 'PAID FOR BY WEIERS 2020' and a volunteer form ('Let's keep Glendale on the comeback trail!'). It is the sitting mayor's campaign site for this 2020 election.
The only copy (2014-01-04, 60 days after the election) is a parked domain page: 'This Web page parked FREE courtesy of Cheap-Registrar'.

The pages from 2016-10-27 and 2016-12-29 belong to his Louisiana State Senate site: 'Senator Mack "Bodi" White Seeks Re-Election to Louisiana Senate District 6', with legislation and district pages. Nothing on the pages mentions the 2016 Baton Rouge mayor-president race.

The 2015-12-11 copy, 38 days after the special election, is a Mike Bell mayoral campaign site ('Built for Toledo | Strong for Toledo') with Volunteer and Donate pages. It has a neighborhoods plan that says 'as mayor I'll be there'.

The site is Cashell's 2006 re-election site ('© 2006 BobCashell.com Bob Cashell for Mayor'). The 2010-02, 2010-12 and 2011-07 copies show the same unchanged 2006 bio and platform. I found no content about the 2010 race.

The 2010-07, 2011-02 and 2011-07 copies show the frozen 2007 campaign site. The latest posts are 'Beutler Wins! ... May 8, 2007' and the footer says '© 2006-2007'. I found no content about the 2011 race.

The electhealy.com pages (2013-09-06) belong to 'Jim' Healy, a DuPage County (Illinois) board member who seeks re-election ('This challenge is why I am running for re-election'). He is not Jerramiah Healy of Jersey City.

The 2012-11-03 and 2012-11-04 copies are an attack site. The site collects negative press about Pulido, for example 'after 18 years of Pulido, the city might be ready for a new mayor' and 'Group seeks grand jury probe of Santa Ana mayor'. It has no donate or volunteer function.

The supplied 2016-01-29 copy is the 2015 thank-you page. A 2017-03-27 archive copy of the same domain is the active re-election site: 'Keep the Mayor. She keeps her promises.' and 'Paid for by Ivy Taylor for Mayor 2017'.
